sourcedFrom: RESERVE™ SERIES SIDE X SIDE BREAK ACTION SHOTGUN — Mossberg International owner's manual — Reserve™ Series Side x Side owner's manual (not printed)
cleanIntro: The side-by-side Reserve comes apart in the same two movements as any break gun, but the forearm is released by a BUTTON rather than a latch — the single detail that most often has an over/under owner prying at the wrong part. Its extractors lift shells for removal by hand rather than throwing them, so both chambers get checked by eye and finger every time.

steps.title: Safety fully rearward to ON
steps.action: Push the tang safety fully back before anything else and keep the muzzle pointed somewhere harmless.
steps.quote: Move the safety button fully rearward to the “ON” (SAFE) position
steps.cite: RESERVE™ SERIES SIDE X SIDE BREAK ACTION SHOTGUN — Mossberg International owner's manual — Reserve™ Series Side x Side owner's manual — UNLOADING

steps.title: ⛔ Open it — the extractor LIFTS the shells, it does not throw them
steps.action: Open the gun and look at what the extractor does: it positions live or spent cartridges for removal by hand. Nothing flies out. If you are used to an ejector gun, this is exactly where a live round gets left sitting proud in a chamber and the gun gets called empty.
steps.quote: The extractor will position live or spent cartridges for removal by hand
steps.cite: RESERVE™ SERIES SIDE X SIDE BREAK ACTION SHOTGUN — Mossberg International owner's manual — Reserve™ Series Side x Side owner's manual — UNLOADING

steps.title: Both chambers, by eye and by finger
steps.action: Check both. On a side-by-side the chambers sit apart and it is genuinely possible to clear one and glance past the other.
steps.quote: Visually and physically check both chambers to be certain the firearm is unloaded.
steps.cite: RESERVE™ SERIES SIDE X SIDE BREAK ACTION SHOTGUN — Mossberg International owner's manual — Reserve™ Series Side x Side owner's manual — UNLOADING

steps.title: Re-prove it empty at the bench
steps.action: Before any work, inspect the chambers again and keep the muzzle in a safe direction. The book asks for this at the head of its own assembly section.
steps.quote: Before assembly and/or performing any work on your firearm, visually and physically inspect the chambers to be sure that the firearm is completely unloaded.
steps.cite: RESERVE™ SERIES SIDE X SIDE BREAK ACTION SHOTGUN — Mossberg International owner's manual — Reserve™ Series Side x Side owner's manual — ASSEMBLY

steps.title: Forearm off — PUSH the release button
steps.action: Find the forearm latch release button at the END of the forearm, push it, and pull the forearm away from the barrels. ⛔ A button that is pushed — not the over/under's latch that is lifted. This is the one step where the sibling gun's procedure actively misleads.
steps.quote: Push the release button and pull the forearm away from the barrels.
steps.cite: RESERVE™ SERIES SIDE X SIDE BREAK ACTION SHOTGUN — Mossberg International owner's manual — Reserve™ Series Side x Side owner's manual — ASSEMBLY

steps.title: Top lever right, barrels off the hinge pin
steps.action: With the forearm off, push the top lever fully right and lift the barrels off the hinge pin — the reverse of the way the book has you put them on, hooking the half-round on the barrel lug onto the receiver's hinge pin at about 45 degrees.
steps.quote: Hook the half-round on the barrel lug onto the hinge-pin in the receiver
steps.cite: RESERVE™ SERIES SIDE X SIDE BREAK ACTION SHOTGUN — Mossberg International owner's manual — Reserve™ Series Side x Side owner's manual — ASSEMBLY

steps.title: Field strip complete — and the maker's boundary
steps.action: Barrels, forearm, stock and receiver. The book names exactly this much as the owner's share and assigns everything past it to Mossberg International or a gunsmith.
steps.quote: but further disassembly should be performed by the manufacturer, Mossberg International and/or a qualified gunsmith only.
steps.cite: RESERVE™ SERIES SIDE X SIDE BREAK ACTION SHOTGUN — Mossberg International owner's manual — Reserve™ Series Side x Side owner's manual — CLEANING AND LUBRICATION

deepAbsentReason: This book publishes no deeper procedure. Its own scope line stops at barrels, forearm and stock and assigns anything further to Mossberg International or a qualified gunsmith. ⛔ No deeper path is invented for it.

cleaning.name: BOTH BORES
tasks: Solvent and brush through each barrel, then patches until clean
A final lightly oiled patch as a protective film
⛔ Leave NOTHING in either bore — a patch is an obstruction
cleaning.quote: Scrub the bores and chambers with solvent and follow with cleaning patches until the barrels are clean.
cleaning.src: RESERVE™ SERIES SIDE X SIDE BREAK ACTION SHOTGUN — Mossberg International owner's manual, CLEANING AND LUBRICATION

cleaning.name: METAL — lightly, and the right lubricant
tasks: Solvent on the metal, then a light film of gun oil
Over-lubrication avoided — it creeps into the stock head
No abrasives anywhere near the finish
cleaning.quote: All metal parts should be cleaned with an appropriate gun cleaning solvent and lightly lubricated with gun oil.
cleaning.src: RESERVE™ SERIES SIDE X SIDE BREAK ACTION SHOTGUN — Mossberg International owner's manual, CLEANING AND LUBRICATION

cleaning.name: ⛔ CAMO FINISHES — solvent discipline
tasks: Keep strong solvents off a camouflage pattern
Wipe the outside with an oiled rag rather than flooding it
cleaning.quote: Camo guns: Caution should be exercised to avoid exposure of camouflage pattern to strong solvents.
cleaning.src: RESERVE™ SERIES SIDE X SIDE BREAK ACTION SHOTGUN — Mossberg International owner's manual, CLEANING AND LUBRICATION

reassembly: Safety ON. Both bores checked clear of patches and oil.
Barrels at roughly 45 degrees to the stock/receiver, half-round onto the hinge pin.
Top lever fully right, swing the barrels up, release the lever and let it centre.
Forearm plate mated to the receiver, forearm swung up firmly under the barrels.
Press the forearm home until the latch engages.
Open and close a few times, then function test.
fncheck: Both chambers proven empty, muzzle safe. Open and close the gun several times to check the barrel assembly moves freely. Closed, safety fully rearward on ON, pull the trigger: the hammer must NOT fall. Finger off, safety fully forward to FIRE: it must not fall on its own. ⛔ If the top lever does not return toward centre when the gun closes, it is not locked up and must not be fired.
